provenance.notes: One Kingbright datasheet per colour and size, opened 2026-10-24 from kingbrightusa.com (the URL serves the current revision). 5 mm: red WP7113ID (DSAF0012 V.14A, 01/08/2026), yellow WP7113YD (DSAF2448 V.11B, 01/08/2026), green WP7113GD (DSAE9335 V.12B, 04/02/2019), blue WP7113QBC/D (DSAG3481 V.18B, 03/26/2025), white WP7113QWC/D (DSAI6407 V.6B, 10/09/2023). 3 mm: red WP7104ID (DSAF2304 V.3, 05/19/2007), yellow WP7104YD (DSAF2337 V.3), green WP7104GD (DSAF2299 V.4), blue WP7104QBC/D (DSAF4262 V.8, 04/07/2010), white WP7104QWC/D (DSAE9924 V.10B, 05/07/2018). Sim keys are <colour>.<size>.<param>. Values come from each sheet's ELECTRICAL/OPTICAL table (VF typ and max, IR max at VR = 5 V) and ABSOLUTE MAXIMUM RATINGS table (IF DC, PD, VR). ifTestMa is the current at which that sheet quotes VF: 10 mA for the 5 mm red, yellow and green sheets, 20 mA for every other sheet, so VF typ is not comparable across sizes (5 mm red 1.9 V at 10 mA, 3 mm red 2.0 V at 20 mA). Fit the diode model to vfTypV at ifTestMa, never at ifMaxMa. Package (5 mm sheets p.1, 3 mm sheets p.1): 5 mm dome ø5, flange ø5.9, flange 1.0 max, overall 8.6 mm, leads 27 mm min, 0.5 mm square, 2.54 mm pitch. 3 mm dome ø2.9 (drawing also shows ø2.8), flange ø3.2, overall 5.4±0.5 mm, same leads and pitch. The cathode is the shorter lead (1.5±1 mm shorter on the 5 mm sheets, 1.5 mm typ on the 3 mm sheets), which matches the SunFounder statement that the longer lead is the anode. Tolerance on unlabelled dimensions is ±0.25 mm. bodyMm is the 5 mm default [flange, flange, overall]. Kit: the component list image shows red, yellow, green, white and blue LEDs x5 and the photo shows round domes, but no SunFounder page states the size or manufacturer, so both sizes are kept and the Kingbright family is a reference, not the kit part number. Spans: minSpan 1 because the native pitch is 2.54 mm; maxSpan 15 = floor((2.54 + 2 x (27 - 8)) / 2.54), where 27 mm is the minimum lead length and the 8 mm per lead bend/insertion allowance is a modelling assumption, not a datasheet value.
